description: Asked once, was told to pour the beer, and moved the cat.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Laid the loaf to the notch and took the answer.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Moved to the settle, off the book.
name: Gib

description: Read the evening prayer and was not asked for more.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Stood the prayer and did not lengthen it.
name: William Shakespeare
